CalibrationPointCsvDAO

class CalibrationPointCsvDAO[source]

Bases: DAO[CalibrationPoint]

DAO for the single CalibrationPoint record in a CSV file.

Attributes:
csv_handlerCSVHandler

Utility for reading and writing CSV data.

calibration_pointsdict[int, CalibrationPoint]

In-memory cache by ID (at most one entry).

file_mapdict[int, str]

CSV file path by ID.

int_propertieslist[str]

Names of the CalibrationPoint fields typed int.

Notes

The record is stored in PathConfig.calibration_point() with ID CalibrationPoint.ID_VALUE and loaded into the cache when the DAO is created. update, delete and list are not implemented and raise NotImplementedError.

write_with_lock

Write rows to a CSV file while holding an exclusive lock.
write_with_lock(filepath, data, headers)[source]

Write rows to a CSV file while holding an exclusive lock.

Parameters:
filepathstr

Full path to the target CSV file.

datalist[dict]

Rows to write, one dictionary per row.

headerslist[str]

Ordered column names; a header row is written first.

Raises:
portalocker.exceptions.LockException

If the lock cannot be acquired within 10 seconds.

Notes

The user directories are created if needed. The file is opened by portalocker.Lock in mode "w" with Python’s defaults, so it uses the platform’s default encoding and newline translation, unlike CSVHandler.write_csv with a path (UTF-8 with BOM).

load_all_calibration_points()[source]

Load the calibration point CSV file into the cache.

Notes

Only the first row of the file is used. Coordinates that are not plain digits, including negative numbers, are loaded as 0.
